interfaces: snapshot.natives(slug, agents, repo, worktrees, environ, run): the production caller. Every swarm snapshot (the snapshot command and the tick's automatic snapshots) records a natives section beside sources: for each agent with a native harness and a conversation id, native.capture from the home its profile validation recorded (else CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or CODEX_HOME, else the user default), looked up under the agent's worktree, then the swarm repo, with the CLI version read once per harness and stopped false. Captured material is kept by sha256 in the swarm's sources folder and pruning counts it; an Unavailable is recorded with its cause and the operator's continue-or-fresh decision. These snapshot copies are recovery material for the operator, not checkpoints: they are not written through a granted ArtifactStore and Validator.commit never sees them. AGENTIHOOKS_SWARM_NATIVE_CAPTURE=0 records none

native.capture(harness, home, session_id, cwd, version_text, stopped, qualified=QUALIFIED): the store-free capture Qualifier.capture wraps and counts; an OSError reading the conversation yields Unavailable native_unreadable

native.Qualifier(validator, qualified=QUALIFIED): capture, checkpoint and restore through the attempt's granted store; metrics() exposes native_resume_success_by_target keyed harness/outcome (captured, resumed, native_resume_unavailable)

Qualifier.capture(harness, home, session_id, cwd, version_text, stopped) returns NativeCapture or Unavailable. Claude: projects/<cwd with every non alphanumeric character a dash>/<id>.jsonl and its companion folder. Codex: the rollout under sessions, located through the threads index read in one read transaction that never waits on a lock (a held exclusive lock yields database_busy), else by file name; a link anywhere on the rollout path under sessions is refused as an escape. Conversation files are read up to their last complete record. Account stores, environment and harness databases are never read into the material

Unavailable(harness, cause): outcome native_resume_unavailable, decision (continue_from_context, start_fresh) left to the operator and recorded in its manifest fields; causes unqualified_harness, unqualified_version, version_changed, native_format_changed, native_too_large, database_busy, conversation_absent, identity_mismatch, native_member_escapes_home, context_only, conversation_present, placement_failed, native_unreadable, or the Validator refusal reason. A checkpoint that is not authoritative is counted under the harness unknown, since its manifest cannot be trusted to name one

Qualifier.checkpoint(native, manifest) stores <checkpoint_id>.native_session before Validator.commit stores the manifest and only when the manifest authority equals the store grant; an Unavailable commits a context continuation with native_resume_capability unsupported; native.merged replaces only the native_session material

Qualifier.restore(checkpoint_id, home, cwd, version_text) returns Resumed(harness, session_id, command) only for an authoritative native checkpoint whose recorded CLI line equals the installed qualified line. It reads every member bounded, checks identity in memory, refuses a link on any unresolved target path, an escape or an existing conversation, then writes each file new (O_EXCL, O_NOFOLLOW, mode 0600) and re-reads the placed files to report the identity. A failed write or read back removes every file and folder it created; placement_failed names an OSError, any other refusal keeps its own cause
tests/integration/native_resume/run_native_proof.sh <dir> claude|codex: the live fresh-home proof; with NATIVE_PROOF_IMAGE set, restore and resume run inside a fresh container of that image

authority: Checkpoint capture writes only through the ArtifactStore granted to the attempt and only when the manifest authority equals that grant; restore reads only through the reader's granted store and only a checkpoint Validator.verify calls authoritative. The swarm snapshot's natives copies are not checkpoints and confer no authority.

limitations: Qualification is per CLI minor line; a new line needs a live proof run and a QUALIFIED entry
A capture while the CLI runs is labelled consistent_export: it ends at the last complete record, which may sit mid turn
Codex databases are not carried; Codex rebuilds its thread index from the rollout, observed live on 0.162.1
Capture bounds (ARCHIVE_MEMBERS, ARCHIVE_BYTES) are checked after the conversation files are read; an oversized conversation is read once, then refused as native_too_large
A restore home whose projects or sessions folder is a link, as in agentihooks profile homes, is refused as an escape; restores target fresh homes
Cleanup after a failed placement suppresses its own errors; a path it cannot remove is left behind
Capture reads through a projects or sessions folder that is itself a link, as in agentihooks profile homes, because it reads the operator's own home; restore refuses that shape

The thread index read uses a file: URI with mode=ro; a SQLite build without URI support would take the name literally and the capture would report native_format_changed. Verified on SQLite 3.37.2 on the workstation and on the CI build
The Claude live proof did not close stdin; Claude waited three seconds for stdin data and warned, then answered correctly
The fresh-container proof ran the worker image under Docker on the workstation, not as a worker Pod on Anton; the Pod proof belongs to the G8 rollout gate

The snapshot runs each CLI's --version on the controller host; an agent whose CLI differs from the controller's is judged by the controller's version and its own conversation record, and a mismatch yields version_changed

Production restore: Qualifier.restore has no production caller in this package; the snapshot is the production capture path and SV2-CKP-04 and SV2-CKP-05 wire checkpoint publish and restore through the worker supervisor

Transcripts are copied verbatim, so tool output a conversation holds, secrets included, is copied too: into the swarm's sources folder (mode 0600, kept while one of ten automatic snapshots names it) and into native checkpoints. No secret scan runs on the material; the exposure equals the CLI's own conversation files

compatibility: SV2-CKP-01 Validator and SV2-CKP-02 source capture are unchanged; a context continuation checkpoint is identical to the earlier path apart from the native_resume extension field
rollout_safety: Disabling native resume is Qualifier(validator, qualified={}); every other checkpoint path is unchanged
consumer_rule: SV2-CKP-04 and SV2-CKP-05 decide native resume from the restore outcome, never from the commit verdict: Validator.commit checks inventory and hashes, not native format, so a manifest written by another writer can commit as native and still restore to native_resume_unavailable (case B)
